mapper.select: SELECT cf.id, cf.user_id AS userId, cf.name, cf.description, cf.is_default AS isDefault, cf.sort_order AS sortOrder, cf.collection_count AS collectionCount, cf.is_public AS isPublic, cf.share_code AS shareCode, cf.share_expire_time AS shareExpireTime, cf.create_time AS createTime, cf.update_time AS updateTime FROM tb_collection_folder cf WHERE cf.user_id = #{userId} AND cf.deleted = 0 ORDER BY cf.is_default DESC, cf.sort_order ASC, cf.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM tb_collection_folder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
